newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish govt body wants Ecu 250 mln duty-free quota.
newsitem.headline: Polish govt body wants Ecu 250 mln duty-free quota.

text.p: The Polish government's economic committee (KERM) on Monday approved a regulation which will create an additional 250 million Ecu duty-free import quota on some electronic equipment, the government said in a statement.
It said the proposed zero-duty quota would also encompass some computer components produced abroad and that such imports would remain duty-free until the end of 1997.
The statement did not specify what electronic equipment or computer parts were included in the quota.
KERM also approved an additional 28.5 million Ecu zero-duty quota for some goods imported for the electronics industry.
KERM's decisions still have to be approved by the full cabinet to become law.
